title: Transfer a file
name: Destination file name
compatibility: The file is copied without re-slicing. Check compatibility with every destination machine and material. You can choose which jobs to start after the copies.
noDestinations: No other machine supports transferring this format.
chooseLaunch: Start on all available machines or only your selection?
confirm: Beds are clear and the files are prepared for these machines and materials.
laserConfirm: I am present at the lasers with laser protection, extraction and clear work areas. Machine profile, material, origin and power are checked.
externalConfirm: External spool only on Bambu/Elegoo, without AMS/CANVAS mapping. The files are prepared for this machine and filament.
noLaunch: No destination is available to start now. Successful copies are kept.
availability: Busy or unavailable machines are excluded. Availability and permissions are checked again before every request and by the server.
select: Select at least one available machine.
invalidName: Use an ASCII file name without folders (maximum 200 characters), with an extension supported by every destination, preserving .3mf format when applicable.
busy: Requests in progress… Keep this dialog open.
noRetry: Requests finished. No automatic retry after failure or unknown outcome. Check the machine before sending another command.

errors.unknown: Outcome unknown. Check the machine; this request will not be replayed.
errors.unavailable: Machine or permission changed; no request sent.
errors.upload-failed: Transfer failed. Check the destination before trying again.
errors.command-unconfirmed: Start not confirmed. The machine may have received the command. No replay.
errors.file-exists: A file with this name already exists.
errors.missing: The source file or machine is no longer available.
errors.upload-busy: A transfer or command is already in progress.
errors.command-busy: A command is already in progress.
errors.command-state: The machine is no longer available to start.
errors.file-too-large: The file exceeds the allowed size.
errors.project-multiple-plates: Projects with multiple plates are not supported.
errors.project-no-gcode: No printable G-code in this project.
errors.sign-in: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.command-rejected: The machine rejected the start request.
errors.laser-confirm: Laser operator presence confirmation is required.
errors.invalid: The server rejected the request parameters.
errors.not-attempted: Not attempted: the batch stopped after permission or session loss.
